title: A chart or title keeps what you set by hand when you change its numbers or style
goal: Changing an animated chart's numbers or theme lays its bars out again and throws away any key or effect the person set by hand on a bar, and restyling a chart or title puts back the theme's version of an effect the person had edited. The person loses work without being told. Keep hand-set keys and edited effects through a change of numbers or style, the way hand-dragged title bars are now kept.
notes: From two audit rough lines nobody filed: queue/audits/2026-10-17-animated-charts.json ('Changing the data or the theme lays the chart's pieces out again: a key or an effect set by hand on one bar is lost (the pieces keep their ids, and a part's retimed in and out are kept)') and queue/audits/2026-10-19-a-title-part-move-dragged-by-hand-on-the-timelin.json ('On a chart, an effect the drawing gave a bar and that you then edited (rather than added) still goes back to the theme's on a restyle; only effects you added are kept'). The model to copy is commit 56d7c8e5 (hand-dragged title part bars survive a restyle). Not reproduced by the manager, so p2 with reproduction as the first item.
acceptance: Reproduced first at Next defaults: drop a Bar chart on a video, key one bar's opacity by hand and edit its shadow, then change one number, then the theme; what was lost goes in this task's log

After a change of numbers or theme, a key set by hand on a bar stays on that bar, and an effect the person edited keeps their values; a bar that goes away (its row removed) takes its own keys with it and nothing else
The same on a title: an effect the person edited, not only one they added, survives a theme, font pair or energy change
A walk at Next defaults proves both and joins the rotating set; unit tests in PhotonzCore for the merge; Scripts/test.sh passes
Audit written under queue/audits/. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: note from a-chart-is-your-data-given-to-it-the-obvious-way: a chart with later sets is now posed at every frame from the numbers of that moment (ChartData.swift, ChartPen.posed); the pose keeps each piece's own style, keys and text settings and only changes place, size, shape and words, so hand-set looks survive there. Stored pieces are still laid out by ChartPen.rebuilt as before.

Reproduced in PhotonzCore (probe test, Next defaults, Bar chart and keynote/lightLeak titles): a bar's hand-set opacity 0.6 and corner radius 3 come back as 1.0 and 0 after one number changes; removing row 1 leaves row 1's hand rotation key on the bar that now shows old row 2 (pieces follow their slot name Bar N, not their row), and old row 2's keys move to old row 3. A hand key added to a bar's opacity keys and an added glow DO survive numbers, theme and an added row (already covered). Title: keynote Subtitle shadow edited to radius 30 red goes back to radius 7.2 white on a theme change; lightLeak Title glow radius edited to 77 snaps back to 18 on an energy or font pair change (every restyle rescales it from the preset).

Built: chart rows told apart by their labels (ChartSpec.rowSources), so a bar's keys, opacity, corners and blending follow its row through new numbers, a theme and a removed row, and a removed row takes only its own. A title remembers the effects its drawing gave every piece (TitleRecipe.drawnEffects); the restyle works on those and then puts back any effect the person edited, added or removed (LayerEffect.keepingHandEdits). Covers shades, glow and grain size under intensity, and the motion blur shutter under energy. Chose keeping an edited effect whole over keeping only the changed field, because a field-by-field merge needs a record per field and the person sees the effect as one thing. Chose matching rows by label with leftovers paired by position (a rename, or a whole table pasted) over adding an id to every row, because rows are typed and pasted as plain text and a stored id would not survive a paste. Walk hand-work-survives-new-numbers-and-a-restyle-walk at Next defaults fails on the old code (step 46: the shadow keys did not survive the number change) and passes now. Neighbouring walks a-dragged-part-bar-survives-a-restyle, animated-charts and chart-from-pasted-data pass. Scripts/test.sh exit 0. Looked at all five pictures: the bar of Q2 is dimmed with its shadow after Q1 is removed and Q3/Q4 are plain; the Sunset title is legible. The missing word Home in picture 6 is the same on the old code (core probe identical); filed a-main-title-headline-keeps-its-second-line-afte. Left rough, under the bar: duplicate labels pair in order; an edited effect no longer follows intensity. Both are in the audit's rough list. Main was red before I started (Space3DExportTests on CI slice 2, unrelated); filed the-2-5d-flip-movie-test-agrees-with-the-canvas at p1.
